Class ViewLoader

java.lang.Object
controller.ViewLoader
public final class ViewLoader extends Object
Keeps all the code for loading FXML files in one place. This is useful because it allows us to easily change how we load FXML files in the future, and it also makes it easier to handle errors when loading FXML files.

  • Method Details

    • load

      public static javafx.scene.Parent load(String fxml_path, Object controller)
      Loads an FXML file and attaches the given controller. Returns null on failure.
      Parameters:
      fxml_path - the path to the FXML file, relative to the classpath
      controller - the controller to attach to the FXML file
      Returns:
      the root node of the loaded FXML file, or null if loading failed

    • open_window

      public static javafx.stage.Stage open_window(String fxml_path, Object controller, javafx.stage.Window owner)
      Opens the FXML file in a new window; owner may be null.
      Parameters:
      fxml_path - the path to the FXML file, relative to the classpath
      controller - the controller to attach to the FXML file
      owner - the window that owns the new window, or null if there is no owner
      Returns:
      the new stage, or null if loading failed
